授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 農業生物科学講座に所属する教員が昆虫、植物、動物に関する最先端の研究を英語で概説しながら、生物資源、農業生産、環境に関する理解を深めてもらう。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Recent advances in agrobiology will be focused in detail. In the field of agrobiology, knowledge from genes to ecosystems is essential to synthetic understanding of the use and conservation of biological resources. While focusing on the recent topics, general introduction to agrobiology will be given to further your knowledge and understanding of the importance of biological resources, agricultural production and agro-environment. Five lecturers in the field of entomology, plant breeding and animal reproduction are in charge of the class.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: biological resources, pest management, plant breeding, molecular biology
